title: Checked damage (draft 0.1.0)
description: One damage a player looked up in the page's checker ("is my damage enough?") during a live raid, as the site stores it in the inbox's `checks` table. No rank: the checker doesn't ask for one. Low-trust by design: no Turnstile check, so the engine must treat it as a hint, never as a report. The same network, server and damage within a few hours is stored once. Damage is in 0.1B (1e8) units.

damage.description: The damage as typed into the checker, in 0.1B (1e8) units. The upper bound is the same units guard as the report's.

checked_at.description: Set by the site when it stored the check (UTC).

client.description: Never an IP address or an account.

season_key.description: SHA-256 (hex) of the site's salt, the season and the client's network: the same `season_key` that network's in-raid reports (report 0.2.0) and final results carry, so the engine can join a check to that network's reports.
